name: Institute for Future Agricultural Leaders (IFAL)
org: NC Farm Bureau (with NC State and other university hosts)
what_you_do: A week-long program for students who like farm and food jobs. You visit agriculture schools and research farms. You join leadership classes and visit farm businesses. You also tour the General Assembly and live in campus dorms.
who_can_apply: Rising high school seniors who are interested in farm and food jobs.
deadline_text: 2026 program was June 14-19, 2026 and the 2026 application is closed. 2027 dates not posted yet.
how_to_apply: Download the application from the NC Farm Bureau IFAL page. Or get one at your county Farm Bureau office.
notes: Dates are last year's. In 2026 the program ran at three campuses (NC State, NC A&T and University of Mount Olive), so the site you attend may differ.
